description: Sales invoice detail report — revenue, metals, diamonds, weights, categories, customers, sales reps

EntryDate.desc: When the stock/history record was created or entered

date.desc: Business date for the stock record or transaction

serialjobno.desc: Serial job number — same as StockBarcode, not a separate column

jobno_excel.desc: Job number from Excel — derived as StockBarcode with underscores removed

IsERPreturn.desc: Boolean: is this an ERP return?

Amount.desc: Total financial amount for the item/transaction

grosswt.desc: Gross weight including metal and stones (grams)

IsSupplierJob.me: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.jobflowfrom,'')='MFGJob' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
IsSupplierJob.desc: Boolean: is the job from an external supplier? (derived from jobflowfrom)

IsJobClosed.desc: Boolean: is the manufacturing job closed? (live only — archive/SideUp hardcode 1)

MetalAmount.desc: Financial value of the precious metal component

OtherAmount.desc: Other charges not categorized as metal/diamond/stone/labour

UnitCost.desc: Cost per unit of the jewellery product

isWithHallMark.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.isWithHallMark,0)=1 THEN 'With HallMark' ELSE 'Without HallMark' END

IsSampleLineJob.desc: Boolean: is this a sample/prototype job?

netwt.desc: Net weight of precious metal after excluding stones (grams)

MetalRate.desc: Per-item metal rate (rate per gram used for this item)

Tunch.desc: Gold purity percentage/fineness measure (maps to metalPriceRatio column)

MetalLoss.desc: Calculated metal loss = MetalDiamondWeightWithLoss + MM_MetalWeightWithLoss - NetWeight

NetWtWithLoss.desc: Net metal weight including manufacturing loss = MetalDiamondWeightWithLoss + MM_MetalWeightWithLoss

ArticleMasterCode.desc: Master article/product code (live/archive only — SideUp hardcodes '')

IsClub.desc: Boolean: is this a clubbed/grouped stock? (derived from GroupJob)

jobtype.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.IsSampleLineJob,0)=1 THEN 'sample line job' WHEN ISNULL(DI.IsSampleLineJob,0)=0 THEN 'Regular Job' ELSE '' END
jobtype.desc: Job classification (sample line job / Regular Job) — derived from IsSampleLineJob

orderform.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.b2c_orderno,'')='' AND ISNULL(DI.b2c_orderno_stock,'')='' THEN 'offline order' ELSE 'online order' END
orderform.desc: Order form type (offline/online) — derived from b2c_orderno and b2c_orderno_stock

Manufacturer.de: CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Stock_Contractorcode,'')<>'' THEN DI.Stock_Contractorcode ELSE ISNULL(DI.Stock_Suppliercode,'') END

SalesRep.de: ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 u.customercode FROM {DBNAME}Usermanagement_systemloginmaster u WHERE u.id = DI.usermanagement_salesrepid),'')

GoldWt.desc: Weight of gold in the item (grams) — SP fallback approximation, GetFullReport uses subquery

SilverWt.desc: Weight of silver in the item (grams) — SP fallback approximation, GetFullReport uses subquery

PlatinumWt.desc: Weight of platinum in the item (grams) — SP fallback approximation, GetFullReport uses subquery

OtherWt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') NOT IN ('gold','silver','platinum') THEN CONVERT(decimal(38,3),ISNULL(DI.netweight,0)-ISNULL(DI.MM_MetalWeightWithLoss,0)-ISNULL(DI.FindingWtWithLoss,0)) ELSE 0 END)
OtherWt.desc: Weight of other metals not gold/silver/platinum (grams) — SP fallback approximation

jewellerysize.desc: Physical size (ring size, bracelet size, necklace length) — not on SideUp table

WastageAmount.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.wastage,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(DI.TotalMetalAmount,0) - CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,3), ISNULL(DI.MetalDiamondWeightWithLoss,0) * (ISNULL(DI.MetalRate,0) * (ISNULL(DI.metalPriceRatio,0) / (ISNULL(DI.metalPriceRatio,0) + ISNULL(DI.wastage,0))))) END)
WastageAmount.desc: Monetary value of manufacturing wastage (note: GetFullReport adds MM_WastageAmount/FindingWastageAmount from subquery — this is the SP fallback)

GoldAmt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') = 'gold' THEN ISNULL(DI.TotalMetalAmount,0) + ISNULL(DI.MM_TotalMetalAmount,0) ELSE 0 END)
GoldAmt.desc: Monetary value of gold component — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery amounts

SilverAmt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') = 'silver' THEN ISNULL(DI.TotalMetalAmount,0) + ISNULL(DI.MM_TotalMetalAmount,0) ELSE 0 END)
SilverAmt.desc: Monetary value of silver component — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery amounts

PlatinumAmt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') = 'platinum' THEN ISNULL(DI.TotalMetalAmount,0) + ISNULL(DI.MM_TotalMetalAmount,0) ELSE 0 END)
PlatinumAmt.desc: Monetary value of platinum component — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery amounts

OtherAmt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') NOT IN ('gold','silver','platinum') THEN ISNULL(DI.TotalMetalAmount,0) + ISNULL(DI.MM_TotalMetalAmount,0) ELSE 0 END)
OtherAmt.desc: Monetary value of other metals — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery amounts

Pure_Gold_Wt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') = 'gold' THEN (ISNULL(DI.MetalDiamondWeightWithLoss,0) + ISNULL(DI.FindingWtWithLoss,0)) * (ISNULL(DI.wastage,0) + ISNULL(DI.metalPriceRatio,0)) / 100 + ISNULL(DI.calculatemetalwtloss,0) ELSE 0 END)
Pure_Gold_Wt.desc: Pure-gold equivalent weight (grams) — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery SUM(IIF) aggregates

Pure_Silver_Wt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') = 'silver' THEN (ISNULL(DI.MetalDiamondWeightWithLoss,0) + ISNULL(DI.FindingWtWithLoss,0)) * (ISNULL(DI.wastage,0) + ISNULL(DI.metalPriceRatio,0)) / 100 + ISNULL(DI.calculatemetalwtloss,0) ELSE 0 END)
Pure_Silver_Wt.desc: Pure-silver equivalent weight (grams) — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery

Pure_Platinum_Wt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') = 'platinum' THEN (ISNULL(DI.MetalDiamondWeightWithLoss,0) + ISNULL(DI.FindingWtWithLoss,0)) * (ISNULL(DI.wastage,0) + ISNULL(DI.metalPriceRatio,0)) / 100 + ISNULL(DI.calculatemetalwtloss,0) ELSE 0 END)
Pure_Platinum_Wt.desc: Pure-platinum equivalent weight (grams) — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery

Pure_Other_Wt.me: (CASE WHEN ISNULL(DI.Metal_Type_Name,'') NOT IN ('gold','silver','platinum') THEN (ISNULL(DI.MetalDiamondWeightWithLoss,0) + ISNULL(DI.FindingWtWithLoss,0)) * (ISNULL(DI.wastage,0) + ISNULL(DI.metalPriceRatio,0)) / 100 + ISNULL(DI.calculatemetalwtloss,0) ELSE 0 END)
Pure_Other_Wt.desc: Purity-adjusted weight of other metals (grams) — SP fallback, GetFullReport uses subquery

special_rules: CRITICAL — metric type disambiguation: "material"/"material used"/"total material"→grosswt (WEIGHT, not amount). "gold amount"/"gold value"→GoldAmt (AMOUNT). "gold weight"/"gold wt"→GoldWt (WEIGHT). "diamond" alone with no amount/weight qualifier→ask clarify. NEVER map material→amount, material→rate, material→GoldAmt. NEVER map gold weight→GoldAmt. NEVER map gold amount→GoldWt.

"courier charges"/"delivery charges"/"shipping"→OtherAmount, but note in the answer: courier is bundled inside Other Charges which also includes misc, wastage and handling fees — it is not a courier-only figure.
prompt_rules.excluded_columns: D_Pcs_Cm, D_Wt_Cm, D_Pcs_Ct, D_Wt_Ct, C_Pcs_Cm, C_Wt_Cm, C_Pcs_Ct, C_Wt_Ct, statusname, Isarchive, IsshowCustomerName, ImgUrl.
